mina: Postmortem quick follow-up: auth-proxy accepted expired tokens during yesterday's rollout due to KV cache not being invalidated on key rotate. Reverted and purged caches. Need owners for remediation and a recurrence detector.
arpit: I'll take the invalidation webhook + security (HMAC). Plan: POST /internal/cache/invalidate {service,kid}. Add batch support. ETA 5d.
kevin: I'll handle lightweight telemetry + metric: auth.stale_accepts and a tiny trace with kid + result + latency. Dashboard panel in 8d.
mina: I'll update playbook and add an alert rule: auth.stale_accepts > 2 in 10m -> page infra+sec. Draft in 48h. Also schedule a tabletop to rehearse rollback + purge.
sec-bot: Created SEC-2071: auth-kv-invalidation. Linked: SEC-2072 (webhook), SEC-2073 (telemetry), SEC-2074 (playbook).
deploy-bot: Rollback executed 07:54 UTC, cache purge 08:01 UTC. No further incidents after 08:05 UTC.
arpit: Ack. I'll include a dry-run mode so ops can test without side effects and add integration tests.
kevin: Ack. Will keep trace payload minimal to avoid PII.
mina: Consolidated owners & ETA: webhook (arpit) 5d; telemetry (kevin) 8d; playbook/tabletop (mina) 48h. Adding this to monthly incident-pattern review.
arpit: I'll open SEC-2072 and post PR link when ready.
mina: Thanks — I'll create a single tracking ticket and ping when the tabletop is scheduled.
